$comment: Project-level Claude Code settings, versioned. Machine-specific grants go to settings.local.json (git-ignored). 'hooks', 'ask', 'deny', the git entries of 'allow', 'attribution', and 'disableAllHooks' and 'permissions.defaultMode', which stay unset, are the kit's, the same in every project: scripts/sync.ps1 copies them and step 0 of verify.ps1 compares them; the other 'allow' entries and this comment are FlatCheck's (the kit's ADR 0028). 'allow' covers git commit, which the PreToolUse hook lets through only on a claude/ branch (the kit's rule "Commits and merges", the kit's ADR 0021); 'ask' makes every merge, push, rebase, tag and forced branch delete (branch -D) prompt the owner, whatever was approved earlier (the same rule, the kit's ADR 0013); a merged branch is deleted with branch -d, which 'allow' covers. 'attribution' is empty so Claude Code adds no Co-Authored-By or PR line, which the same rule forbids. Hooks: PreToolUse refuses a git commit the model attempts off a claude/ branch, runs verify before the others and blocks --no-verify; PostToolUse records which files this session edited; Stop refuses to end a turn that edited code (the folders kit.json names) until verify ran green, and a turn that edited a shared folder (scripts/, .claude/skills/, .claude/agents/, .claude/rules/kit/), which are the kit's (ADR 0048, ADR 0049; the kit's ADR 0028).
